vo.en: You’re being trapped by furniture stores.

visual.description: A man looking confused and walking through a dark, narrow corridor with neon directional arrows.

vo.en: That maze isn’t a design mistake; it’s a fixed-path layout built to kill your internal sense of direction.

visual.description: An overhead view of a complex floor plan or a miniature architectural model of a maze.

vo.en: It’s the Gruen Effect, which intentionally blurs your logic until your shopping list is completely forgotten.

visual.description: A macro close-up of a man's eye with fast-moving colorful lights reflected in the pupil.

vo.en: But here is the creepy part: look closer at the Bulla Bulla strategy.

visual.description: A large pile of thousands of small, identical objects falling into a massive container.

vo.en: They dump huge bins of random items everywhere to trigger a bargain reflex, forcing you to grab items on impulse.

visual.description: Close-up of a man's hands rapidly grabbing various small products and tossing them into a basket.

vo.en: You went in for one lightbulb, but leave with a mountain of things you don't need.

visual.description: A man pushing a heavily loaded shopping trolley through an exit door into a night parking lot.

vo.en: Subscribe for more brain hacks and comment your most useless purchase, because you’re being...

visual.description: A hand tapping a glowing digital button on a futuristic glass interface.
